title: Independently observe exact-current /governance receipt and close N114 only if locally proven
previous: N114 issuer/successor handoff is preserved, but current-runtime receipt READ remains NOT_YET_PROVEN_CURRENT
required_proof: observe exact-current /governance over the live runtime
read prior durable ACTION_RECEIPT without mutating it
verify freshness and reject future/stale receipt
success_paths: all checks pass => ACTION_RECEIPT=PASS_LOCAL; N114 may close; promotion remains DENY
failure_paths: any check missing/mismatch/unknown => ACTION_RECEIPT=NOT_YET_PROVEN_CURRENT; record failure evidence; promotion remains DENY
forbidden_paths: issuer evidence treated as current verification
completion_gate: independent exact-current /governance observation proves prior-runtime receipt admission locally; otherwise remain DENY and hand off failure evidence
